describe: Dark sci-fi goal-picker screen: a spaceship interior with a large curved window on the left wall, warm lamp and bookshelf on the far left, and a neon purple-blue futuristic cityscape with planets and stars filling the right two thirds. A boy in a blue jacket points up at a glowing star while the white-and-blue Nova robot waves beside him, both standing on a glowing circular platform. UI is a left column of six goal cards under a headline, a top logo/progress/language bar, a floating constellation of five labelled goal nodes on the right, a small Nova speech bubble, and a wide CONTINUE button at bottom right.
